title: National rail safety regulator takes over in Victoria
summary: From 2 December 2019 the national rail safety regulator took over rail safety regulation in Victoria directly from Transport Safety Victoria. Victoria had joined the national scheme in 2014, but until then the national regulator worked through a service agreement with the state regulator.

instruments.title: Rail Safety National Law Application Act 2013 (Vic)
instruments.provisions: applies the Rail Safety National Law in Victoria

commenced.what: Rail safety regulation transferred to ONRSR

direction_rationale: Moving Victorian rail operators onto direct national regulation removes a separate state layer, so interstate operators deal with one regulator.
